messages:
mike_support: Heads-up — escalating BrightPath onboarding to CS. Customer hit repeated 502s when ingesting initial dataset, onboarding flow blocked, customer is >80% through trial and PM flagged renewal risk. Need immediate enablement + comms plan.

mike_support: Error from infra logs:
```
POST /v1/ingest 502 Bad Gateway
trace id=abc123
client-id=brightpath-prod
payload size=12MB
```
We retried, same result. No schema mismatch in our validation layer. Seen across two regions (us-west-2, eu-west-1).

mike_support: Ticket #ZD-5421 created, customer is getting anxious, they called support asking for an ETA.

ops-bot: Ticket ZD-5421 linked to this thread. Priority: P1 -> urgent. Notified on-call infra and infra-ml.

sarah_csm: Thanks for the flag @mike_support. Adding CS triage: I can join a sync in 15. Who's owning the post-mortem/comms? We need a one-line summary for the customer and a repro timeline.

jane_enablement: I can do an immediate enablement touchpoint and walk them through a small ingestion test to isolate size vs. model. I have a pared-down runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ingest-troubleshoot

alex_accountmgmt: FYI renewal touchpoint scheduled next week. If onboarding fails today we risk them cancelling. Suggest we offer a short extension + dedicated enablement call. I'll draft a renewal-friendly comms line once we have root cause.

mike_support: Quick notes from debug: size looks ok, but KV cache spikes during initial batch. Suspecting batching + prefix cache OOM on older GPU instances. Infra-ML is investigating kernel mismatch on quantized variant.

sarah_csm: Plan: (1) immediate enablement call (jane) to attempt a minimal ingest and collect request IDs, (2) infra-ml hotfix attempt or fallback to non-quantized model variant (mike + infra), (3) customer comms: hold on public-facing ETA, offer 1-hr private session now + 1-week trial extension if onboarding remains blocked. Agree?

jane_enablement: I have availability in 20 minutes. I'll run the minimal ingest with their sample and record steps. If we can repro I'll escalate to infra-ml and capture the exact request ID + payload.

mike_support: infra-ml acknowledged, @infra-ml on call. For fallback, we can route BrightPath to model:open-compat-1.2 (non-quant) for tonight to unblock.

alex_accountmgmt: Approved offering the extension + dedicated session. I'll draft the email: short, apologetic, action items, offer extension. Sharing draft in 10.

sarah_csm: Good. After the call, please post the repro steps + request IDs here. I'll own the customer comms thread and renewal note in CRM. Also capturing feedback for product re: ingestion guidance.

mike_support: Post-call update: jane reproduced 502 with sample, request id=abc123. Infra-ML pushed fallback route for BrightPath to open-compat-1.2, ingestion succeeded on retry. Customer now onboarding again.

jane_enablement: Confirmed – we completed minimal ingest, then full ingest succeeded on fallback. Logged steps in runbook and attached sample payload. Recommended action: infra-ml to roll a patch for quant kernel; temporary doc note added to troubleshooting.

sarah_csm: Closing loop: I'll send the customer a short comms note: apology, what we did (fallback + enablement), ETA for patch (TBD by infra-ml), and 1-week trial extension. Also escalated renewal to AMs. Thanks everyone.

ops-bot: Reminder: create postmortem within 72h and link ZD-5421.
